mvgam_forecast object description

Source: R/mvgam_forecast-class.R
mvgam_forecast-class.Rd

A mvgam_forecast object returned by function hindcast or forecast. Run methods(class = "mvgam_forecast") to see an overview of available methods.

Details

A mvgam_forecast object contains the following elements:

  • family character description of the observation distribution.

  • family_pars list containing draws of family-specific parameters (e.g. shape, scale, overdispersion). Only returned when type = "link"; otherwise NULL.

  • type The type of predictions included ("link", "response", "expected", or "trend").

  • series_names Factor of series names, taken from levels(data$series) in the original model fit.

  • train_observations, train_times Lists of length n_series holding the training responses and the time of each hindcast column. A closure-unit family's "expected" and "response" hindcasts have one column per visit. Their times repeat.

  • test_observations, test_times If forecast() produced the object, the corresponding test response vectors and time grids. NULL otherwise (e.g. from hindcast()).

  • hindcasts Named list of posterior hindcast draw matrices, one (ndraws x n_train) matrix per series.

  • forecasts Named list of posterior forecast draw matrices when produced by forecast(), otherwise NULL.

  • site_units TRUE when the fit came from jsdgam(). Its units are sites, which plot() refuses to draw along a time axis.

  • component The state components of the trend the draws hold, such as "slope", or NULL for the summed trend. Set through the component argument of hindcast.mvgam() and forecast.mvgam().

See also

mvgam, hindcast.mvgam, forecast.mvgam
